## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the lightweight handheld microphone and transfer it to the other hand.

Task description: The target is the microphone lying on the left side of the table, with a silver mesh head and black handle. This round requires a handoff from the left hand to the right, which must hold it suspended.

Success criteria: The microphone has transferred to the right hand, is right of the robot centerline, and is suspended approximately twenty centimeters or more above the table. The right gripper is closed and physically contacts it, while the left gripper is open and has released it.

## Execution tips

- For the initial grasp, choose the straight section of the black handle near the silver mesh head, allowing the pads to contact it fully while leaving a section near the handle end available for handoff.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the handle, closing across the shaft. Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides rather than overlapping in the image with no grasp.
- During the handoff, use different grasp positions on the handle. Release the left hand only after the right has a secure grasp and the microphone no longer slips, to avoid losing support or colliding the grippers.
